title: Ailish 3.0
author: Raquel L.
desc:
How Hard To Train
For compound lifts (barbell and smith machine work):
first 2 sets hard
last set to absolute failure - this is reflected in the RPE

For isolation work on machines:
basically murder them



For this program it runs for 12 weeks so we can approach with a double progression model.
Example:
3 sets x 8-10 reps
once all 3 sets hit 10 reps → add weight to the lift

Usually a 2.5kg increase is suitable for most exercises here

ex.note: These 2 sets will be to failure - HARD squeeze at the top of these reps
You can swap the Lat Pulldown for pullups (banded if needed) to switch things up, just aim for a lower rep range of 6-8 if you do pullups.

The set range here is 2-3.
If you feel like you can make it to a final 3rd AMRAP set that will be great.
These 2 sets will be to failure. Swinging the weights up on those final few reps is fine - We want to make sure we get the work in so if you have to shithouse them up a bit that's no worries.

Superset these with the Tricep Rope pushdowns.
So no break in between movements - You'll do one set of the bicep curls and go straight into the tricep pushdowns

Dont ego lift these.
Focus on a deep stretch + controlled tempo.
Use your wrist straps to help with grip so you can focus on mind+muscle connection
Do these sets to failure - You can alternate between either seated or laying hamstring curl, just make sure you note down your weights and increase as the weeks go on.

Sets here should go to 2-3
Again, if you have the fuel in the tank to make that 3rd set and take it to failure it will be really good volume for your glute med
If you can do these as decline sit ups even better, will feel more comfortable for your spine
